name: Complexity ladder three prompts
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/asm && S=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--gemma-3-270m-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && for P in "What is 2+2?" "What is the capital of France?" "Name three colors."; do F=$(echo "$P" | tr " +?" "__"); printf "%s\n" "$P" | timeout 150 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/vocab.bin 2 c ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/bpe.bin 700 950 48 > /tmp/ladder_"$F".log 2>&1; echo "== $P (exit $?)"; awk "/chat ready/{f=1} f" /tmp/ladder_"$F".log | tail -n +3 | head -6 | cut -c1-55; done'
